# Company archetypes

The fallback when a company isn't in the dataset, or there's no web access. These are **generic patterns**, not claims about any specific company. Always say which archetype you're using.

| Archetype | Typical examples | OA | Technical rounds | System design | HR / values | Resume screen |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Mass recruiter / service** | IT services and consulting firms hiring at scale on campus | Aptitude + logical + verbal + CS MCQ + 1–2 easy coding; often adaptive; 90–180 min | 1 technical (core subjects, project, basic coding) | Rare | 1 HR (relocation, bond, shifts, communication) | CGPA cutoffs, no active backlogs, clean format |
| **Product / mid-size tech** | Product companies, unicorns, SaaS | 2–3 coding (medium), 60–90 min | 2–3 DSA rounds, mediums with follow-ups | LLD for new grads, HLD for 1+ yrs | Hiring manager: projects, ownership | Strong projects, internships, DSA proof (ratings) |
| **Big tech** | Large global tech companies | 2 coding (medium–hard), 60–90 min | 3–5 rounds: DSA heavy, plus behavioral against published values | HLD/LLD from SDE-2; light for new grads | Structured behavioral against values or principles | Impact bullets with metrics, scale, internships at known companies |
| **Early startup** | Seed to Series B | Take-home or practical task, sometimes none | Practical coding (build an endpoint, debug real code), pair programming | Pragmatic design of their actual product | Founder chat: ownership, speed, culture | Shipped things, real users, GitHub, breadth |
| **Fintech / trading** | Trading firms, payments companies | Hard DSA + maths/probability puzzles | DSA hard, low-level (C++), concurrency | Low-latency, correctness, idempotency | Pressure, precision | Contest ratings, strong CGPA, systems projects |
| **FAANG-style new-grad internship conversion** | Intern → full-time | 1–2 coding | 2 DSA rounds | None | Light | Projects + DSA |
